::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 11th 1859  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, C0171: Box 29.
:::

Sir,
I have much pleasure in acknowledging the safe arrival of your thank offering for the [Hospital for Sick Children](organizations/other_3.qmd) in Great Ormond Street. I am this morning forwarding it to the Assistant Secretary [Mr S Whitford](people/person_1811.qmd), 4, Porter Street Leicester Square. I am sure from the particulars I learn from ladies constantly in the habit of visiting there that it is a most valuable and well conducted charity; and that your donation will be well bestowed.

With thanks for giving me so pleasant a commission, as well as for letting me know the cause

Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge
